label: TP
reason: Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is alert-TP: user input from request.getParameterMap() flows directly into the SQL query string at line 54 without parameterization or sanitization, enabling SQL injection. Alert 1 (java/xss) is alert-FP: although user input reaches the sql variable, the sink at lines 72-73 (error message output) applies encodeForHTML() to the sql string before printing to response.getWriter(), neutralizing the XSS risk.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request.getParameterMap() into param variable
SQL query constructed with unsanitized user input (SQL injection vulnerability)
XSS sink prints encoded sql via encodeForHTML() - mitigates XSS
